# Custom agents

Place workspace-level VS Code custom agents here using the `.agent.md` format.

`orchestrator.agent.md` assumes that the following agent names will be added:
`Context`, `Planner`, `Troubleshooter`, `Critic`, `Coder`, `Reviewer`,
`Validator`, and `Knowledge Curator`.

Use explicit ownership boundaries and artifact-based handoffs. Do not give every
agent broad write authority by default.
